# peepshow

> Turn a video — or a YouTube link, a live stream, or an animated GIF/APNG/WebP —
> into an ordered timeline of still frames plus an extracted audio track and its
> transcript, so an LLM can "watch" and "listen" to footage it cannot read
> natively. Ships as a CLI, a Claude Code plugin, a Gemini CLI extension, and
> native manifests for Cursor, Windsurf, Cline and Codex. Every run can fan out
> to 95 pluggable sinks. MIT licensed, current version 0.9.4.

Static images are already readable by most multimodal models. peepshow exists for
inputs that have multiple frames across time, which they cannot consume directly.
Install the runtime with `npm i -g peepshow`; it falls back to a bundled ffmpeg
when none is on PATH.

## Start here

- [Homepage](https://www.peepshow.dev/): what it does, install, the frame-extraction pipeline
- [README](https://github.com/t0mtaylor/peepshow/blob/main/README.md): full CLI reference: flags, exit codes, input sources, env vars
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/t0mtaylor/peepshow/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the invocation contract for any agent — read this first if you are an LLM
- [Releases](https://www.peepshow.dev/releases/): user-facing changes per version
- [Report format](https://www.peepshow.dev/report/): the HTML report + manifest.json each run writes
- [Transcription](https://www.peepshow.dev/transcription/): whisper.cpp and cloud providers, token costs

## Using it from an agent

- [Claude Code](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/claude-code/): The reference integration — drag-and-drop auto-invoke included.
- [Cursor](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/cursor/): Project-level rules auto-load when peepshow is installed.
- [Windsurf](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/windsurf/): Cascade rules pick up peepshow without config.
- [Cline](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/cline/): `.clinerules/` convention — zero setup.
- [Codex CLI](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/codex/): SessionStart hook announces peepshow to the model.
- [Gemini CLI](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/gemini/): A real extension — two slash commands, one install line, no MCP server.
- [AGENTS.md](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/agents-md/): Zed AI · Codex Agents · GitHub Copilot — convention-based pickup.
- [Agents Marketplace](https://www.peepshow.dev/agents/agents-marketplace/): Cross-agent plugin registry (emerging).

## Per-model guides

- [Gemini](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/gemini/): Native video + peepshow = control plane for long footage, animated formats, and cost ceilings.
- [Claude](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/claude/): Claude reads images. peepshow turns a video into a timeline Claude already knows how to reason about.
- [GPT-4o / GPT-5](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/gpt/): GPT vision is image input only. peepshow turns video + animated formats into the frame timeline GPT can ingest.
- [Local LLMs](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/local/): Same peepshow pipeline, offline. Frames into Llama 3.2 Vision / Qwen2.5-VL / Pixtral / LLaVA via Ollama or LM Studio.
- [Grok](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/grok/): Grok vision is image input only. peepshow turns video + animated formats into the frame timeline Grok ingests.
- [Mistral](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/mistral/): Pixtral and Mistral Large 3 read images. peepshow extracts the frame timeline that lets them reason about video.
- [Qwen](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/qwen/): Qwen3-VL 235B reads short video natively. peepshow normalises long clips and bridges the smaller sizes — same artifact, every variant.
- [DeepSeek](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/deepseek/): DeepSeek-OCR reads images with OCR precision. peepshow extracts the frame timeline so it reads video as a sequence of stills.
- [Cohere Command A Vision](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/cohere/): Command A Vision is enterprise-focused, OCR-grade, image-only. peepshow turns video into the 20-image batch it natively accepts.
- [Cohere Aya Vision](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/aya/): Aya Vision is Cohere's multilingual research VLM — 23+ languages, OCR-strong, image-only. peepshow turns video into the frame batch it natively reads.
- [NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano Omni](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/nemotron/): Nemotron 3 Nano Omni reads vision, audio, and text in a single 30B MoE. peepshow keeps it predictable across long clips.
- [Phi-4 Multimodal](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/phi/): Phi-4-multimodal runs on a laptop. peepshow caps frame count so even a 5.6B vision model handles arbitrary video.
- [Reka](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/reka/): Reka ingests video, audio, and image in one call. peepshow caps cost on long footage and slots in animated formats.
- [IBM Granite 4.1 Vision](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/granite/): Granite 4.1 Vision is small, governed, document-grade, image-only. peepshow turns video into the chart / table / page sequence it was trained on.
- [SigLIP 2](https://www.peepshow.dev/models/siglip/): SigLIP 2 is an image embedder, not a chat model. peepshow turns a video into the frame batch it forward-passes — vectors then go straight to Chroma / Qdrant / Pinecone.

## How-to

- [GIF to LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/gif-to-llm/): Drop a `.gif`, get every motion frame any vision LLM can read.
- [YouTube to LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/youtube-to-llm/): Pair peepshow with yt-dlp to turn any YouTube URL into a frame timeline + transcript any LLM reads.
- [Transcribe video locally](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/transcribe-video-locally/): peepshow + whisper.cpp = local-only transcript. Zero network. Zero PII leakage.
- [CCTV → LLM analysis](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/cctv-llm-analysis/): Scene detect + perceptual dedup turn a 12-hour CCTV reel into 30 frames an LLM can review.
- [Live stream → LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/live-stream-to-llm/): Drop an `.m3u8`, `.mpd`, or `rtsp://` URL straight into peepshow. ffmpeg reads the stream natively; --duration caps the window.
- [Video → Notion](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/video-to-notion/): peepshow's Notion sink creates a page per run — metadata properties, embedded thumbnails, full frame gallery.
- [Video → Slack](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/video-to-slack/): Slack sink fires on every peepshow run — title, thumbnail, deep link to the first scene frame.
- [Loom → LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/loom-to-llm/): Download the Loom .mp4, run peepshow, get scene frames + whisper transcript.
- [APNG → LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/apng-to-llm/): peepshow unrolls APNGs into JPEG sequences any vision model reads.
- [Animated WebP → LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/webp-animated-to-text/): peepshow handles animated WebP that vision APIs reject or flatten.
- [Screen recording → LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/screen-recording-to-llm/): Drop the .mov / .mp4, get scene frames + a transcript — bug repros, design reviews, QA evidence.
- [Video → Obsidian](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/video-to-obsidian/): peepshow's Obsidian sink writes a markdown note per run with embedded frames + an index entry.
- [Video → SQLite](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/video-to-sqlite/): peepshow's SQLite sink builds a frame + transcript archive any SQL tool searches.
- [Dashcam → LLM](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/dashcam-llm/): Scene-detect + perceptual dedup pinpoint the incident frames so the LLM reviews only what matters.
- [Video → GraphQL](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/video-to-graphql/): peepshow's GraphQL sink turns every run into a typed mutation against your schema.
- [Video → Graphify](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/video-to-graphify/): Run peepshow, then `graphify` the output folder — Claude / Cursor / Gemini agents query the video timeline as a knowledge graph.
- [OCR video frames](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/ocr-video-frames/): peepshow's `--ocr` pass runs Tesseract on every extracted frame so text-only LLMs get the words on-screen.
- [Object-gated frames](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/object-gated-frames/): `--require-objects person,car` drops every frame that doesn't contain at least one of the requested classes.
- [Frame embeddings → vector search](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/frame-embeddings-vector-search/): `--embed-frames` runs CLIP/SigLIP per frame so vector sinks (Chroma, Qdrant, Pinecone, pgvector, Redis, Weaviate, Milvus) get pre-computed vectors.
- [Blur PII in frames](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/blur-pii-in-frames/): `--blur faces|plates|both` runs EgoBlur per frame so frames leaving the box stay GDPR-clean.
- [Speaker diarisation](https://www.peepshow.dev/how-to/speaker-diarisation/): `--diarise` labels every transcript segment with `speaker_0`, `speaker_1`, etc. Local via WhisperX; cloud via Deepgram / AssemblyAI.

## Comparisons

- [peepshow vs Gemini native video](https://www.peepshow.dev/vs/gemini-native-video/): Native video on Gemini works. peepshow wins on cost, long clips, animated formats, and audit.
- [peepshow vs hand-rolled ffmpeg](https://www.peepshow.dev/vs/ffmpeg-manual/): Yes you can roll your own. peepshow is what you'd end up writing — plus sinks, transcripts, dedup, and a dashboard.
- [peepshow vs OpenAI video](https://www.peepshow.dev/vs/openai-video/): GPT-4o / GPT-5 have no native video input. peepshow is the bridge.
- [peepshow vs whisper.cpp standalone](https://www.peepshow.dev/vs/whisper-cli/): If you only need transcription, whisper.cpp is enough. peepshow's win is frames + transcript + sinks in one go.

## Sinks

A sink is any executable that reads peepshow's JSON payload on stdin, so a run can
land in whatever store you already use. 95 ship built in.

- [All sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/): the full index
- [Use-case finder](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/find/): pick a sink by what you want to do
- [SQL & document sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/sql/): Persist every run into a queryable store — SQLite, Postgres, MongoDB.
- [Vector + AI memory sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/vector-memory/): Index frames for semantic recall — Chroma, Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, MemPalace.
- [Object + file storage sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/storage/): Durable uploads to S3-compatible, GCS, Azure, Dropbox, GDrive, Box.
- [Chat & messaging sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/chat/): Post the run summary into Slack, Discord, Teams, Telegram, Matrix and more.
- [Issue trackers sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/issues/): Attach frames as evidence on Linear, GitHub, Jira, Asana, ClickUp, Trello.
- [Wiki & notes sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/wiki/): Drop a per-run page into Notion, Obsidian, Logseq, Outline, Confluence.
- [Whiteboards & canvas sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/whiteboard/): Lay frames out on Miro or drop a comment on a Figma file.
- [Product analytics sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/analytics/): Log a peepshow run as a product event — PostHog, Plausible, Mixpanel/Amplitude/Segment.
- [Observability sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/observability/): Attach run evidence to Sentry issues, Datadog events, PagerDuty incidents.
- [Workflow & glue sinks](https://www.peepshow.dev/sinks/workflow/): Generic surfaces — webhook, GraphQL, IDE attachment folders.
